note: Rewordings of the 16 Q2 corpus theses. Each keeps every fact of its base and changes only how it is said. See the header of tests/q2-reword-stability.ts for the rules, the five kinds, and how to add rewordings written by someone else.

kinds.reorder: same sentences and clauses, different order; wording otherwise unchanged
kinds.plain: everyday first-person wording with contractions; same keys as the base
kinds.terse: telegraphic note style with fragments and abbreviations; same keys as the base
kinds.formal: formal analyst register; same keys as the base
kinds.flat: one free-text paragraph in `thesis` and no helper keys: the basis, the size, the maximum loss and the exit are all in the sentence, the way a stranger types a trade idea into one box
